options.content: 🤖 AI mode🚨 Anomaly detection💾 Memory advisory|🔗 AWR+SAR correlation🖥️ SAR overview|📊 AWR trends📌 Classic (Rules)

⚠️
Advisory Disclaimer — Recommendations are based on AWR snapshot data and statistical analysis. All must be reviewed, validated, and tested in a non-production environment before implementation. Avekshaa Technologies accepts no liability for outcomes without appropriate DBA review.

ℹ️ Correlation Intelligence v2 — Three always-visible, fact-based correlation panels. No configuration required.
Panel 1 — Wait Events → Correlated Segments: Top wait events matched to segments by the correct AWR statistic per wait class (physical reads for User I/O · buffer busy for Concurrency · row locks for Application · GC busy for Cluster). Events with no segment correlation show inline advisory text.
Panel 2 — Segments → Implied Wait Classes + SQLs: Top segments by severity with implied wait classes, object metadata (BLEVEL, CF ratio, row count, stale stats), and SQL IDs that reference this segment in their SQL text (from AWR SQL text section). Referencing SQLs shows only SQL IDs whose text contains the segment name — blank if the SQL uses dynamic SQL or does not reference the segment by name in its text.
Panel 3 — SQL → Referenced Segments + Wait Context: Top SQL by severity with segments extracted from SQL text, and top 3 foreground waits as snap-range context. Segments Referenced shows only objects found by parsing the SQL text — blank for dynamic SQL. Top 3 Waits is snap-range context (not per-SQL causation — Oracle AWR does not link specific waits to specific SQL IDs).

panels.title: 📊 Top Issues — Wait Events · SQL · Segments (Severity Score)

targets.rawSql: WITH f AS (  SELECT begin_snap, event::text AS event, SUM(pct_time) AS event_pct_snap  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv  WHERE dbname='$dbname'    AND instance='$instance'    AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int  GROUP BY begin_snap, event ), t AS (  SELECT begin_snap, SUM(pct_time) AS total_pct_snap  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv  WHERE dbname='$dbname'    AND instance='$instance'    AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int  GROUP BY begin_snap ) SELECT f.event AS name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.event_pct_snap) / NULLIF(SUM(t.total_pct_snap),0), 2) AS value FROM f JOIN t USING (begin_snap) GROUP BY f.event ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sql_id::text AS name, ROUND(AVG(severity_score)::numeric,2) AS value FROM awr_sql_summary_mv WHERE '$dbname'!='' AND '$instance'!='' AND '$start_snap'!='' AND '$end_snap'!=''   AND dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'   AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int GROUP BY sql_id ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT object_name::text AS name, ROUND(AVG(severity_score)::numeric,2) AS value FROM awr_segment_summary_mv WHERE '$dbname'!='' AND '$instance'!='' AND '$start_snap'!='' AND '$end_snap'!=''   AND dbname='$dbname' AND instance='$instance'   AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('$start_snap',' - ',1)::int AND split_part('$end_snap',' - ',1)::int GROUP BY object_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10;

panels.title: ⏱️ Panel 1 — Wait Events → Correlated Segments (matched by AWR stat: physical reads / buffer busy / row locks / GC busy)

matcher.options: ^(Phys Reads|Logical Reads|Buf Busy Waits|Row Lock Waits|Table Scans|GC Busy|Disk Reads|Buffer Gets|Executions|Parse Calls|Total Elapsed.*|Avg Elapsed.*|Total CPU.*|Total Waits|Avg Wait.*)$

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel 1: Wait Events → Correlated Segments
-- Note: Segment data requires awr_segment_summary_mv to be refreshed
-- after the schema fix (run schema/refresh_segment_mv.sql first)
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    split_part('${start_snap}',' - ',1)::int AS s_snap,
    split_part('${end_snap}',' - ',1)::int   AS e_snap,
    '${dbname}'   AS dbname,
    '${instance}' AS instance
),
top_waits AS (
  SELECT
    w.event,
    w.wait_class,
    w.wait_scope,
    ROUND(AVG(w.pct_time)::numeric, 2)         AS pct_db_time,
    ROUND(SUM(w.total_wait_time_s)::numeric, 1) AS total_wait_s,
    ROUND(AVG(w.avg_wait_ms)::numeric, 2)       AS avg_wait_ms,
    SUM(w.waits)                                AS total_waits,
    MAX(m.corr_type)                            AS corr_type,
    MAX(m.seg_filter)                           AS seg_filter,
    MAX(m.guidance_text)                        AS guidance_text
  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv w
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname = w.dbname AND p.instance = w.instance
  LEFT JOIN awr_wait_event_master m ON lower(m.event) = lower(w.event)
  WHERE w.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
  GROUP BY w.event, w.wait_class, w.wait_scope
  ORDER BY AVG(w.pct_time) DESC
  LIMIT 15
),
corr_segments AS (
  SELECT
    tw.event,
    tw.corr_type,
    string_agg(
      s.owner || '.' || s.object_name ||
      ' (' || s.obj_type || ')' ||
      CASE tw.corr_type
        WHEN 'io_read'     THEN ' reads='      || ROUND(s.physical_reads::numeric,0)::text
        WHEN 'io_write'    THEN ' writes='     || ROUND(s.physical_writes::numeric,0)::text
        WHEN 'buffer_busy' THEN ' buf_busy='   || ROUND(s.buffer_busy_waits::numeric,0)::text
        WHEN 'row_lock'    THEN ' row_locks='  || ROUND(s.row_lock_waits::numeric,0)::text
        WHEN 'gc_cluster'  THEN ' gc_busy='    || ROUND(s.gc_buffer_busy::numeric,0)::text
        ELSE ''
      END ||
      COALESCE((
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN UPPER(om.object_type) LIKE 'INDEX%'
              THEN ' [BLVL=' || COALESCE(om.blevel::text,'?') ||
                   CASE WHEN om.blevel > 4 THEN ' ⚠HIGH' ELSE '' END ||
                   CASE WHEN om.clustering_factor IS NOT NULL AND om.num_rows > 0
                        AND (om.clustering_factor::numeric/om.num_rows) > 0.5
                        THEN ' ⚠CF-POOR' ELSE '' END || ']'
            WHEN UPPER(om.object_type) LIKE 'TABLE%'
              THEN ' [rows=' || TO_CHAR(COALESCE(om.num_rows,0),'FM999,999,999') ||
                   CASE WHEN om.partitioned='YES' THEN ' PART' ELSE '' END || ']'
            ELSE ''
          END
        FROM awr_object_metadata om
        WHERE UPPER(om.dbname) = UPPER((SELECT dbname FROM params))
          AND UPPER(om.owner) = UPPER(s.owner)
          AND UPPER(om.object_name) = UPPER(s.object_name)
        LIMIT 1
      ), ''),
      E'\n'
      ORDER BY
        CASE tw.corr_type
          WHEN 'io_read'     THEN COALESCE(s.physical_reads,0)
          WHEN 'io_write'    THEN COALESCE(s.physical_writes,0)
          WHEN 'buffer_busy' THEN COALESCE(s.buffer_busy_waits,0)
          WHEN 'row_lock'    THEN COALESCE(s.row_lock_waits,0)
          WHEN 'gc_cluster'  THEN COALESCE(s.gc_buffer_busy,0)
          ELSE 0
        END DESC
    ) AS correlated_segments
  FROM top_waits tw
  -- Join segment MV with CORRECT filters including instance
  JOIN awr_segment_summary_mv s
    ON s.dbname   = (SELECT dbname   FROM params)
   AND s.instance = (SELECT instance FROM params)
   AND s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
   AND tw.corr_type NOT IN ('none', '') AND tw.corr_type IS NOT NULL
   -- seg_filter: restrict to index/table types per wait event
   AND (
     tw.seg_filter = 'all'
     OR (tw.seg_filter = 'index_only'
         AND UPPER(s.obj_type) IN ('INDEX','INDEX PARTITION','INDEX SUBPARTITION','LOB INDEX'))
     OR (tw.seg_filter = 'table_only'
         AND UPPER(s.obj_type) IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION','CLUSTER','LOB'))
   )
   -- Only include segments that have a non-zero value for the relevant stat
   AND (
     (tw.corr_type = 'io_read'     AND COALESCE(s.physical_reads,0)      > 0)
     OR (tw.corr_type = 'io_write' AND COALESCE(s.physical_writes,0)     > 0)
     OR (tw.corr_type = 'buffer_busy' AND COALESCE(s.buffer_busy_waits,0)> 0)
     OR (tw.corr_type = 'row_lock'    AND COALESCE(s.row_lock_waits,0)   > 0)
     OR (tw.corr_type = 'gc_cluster'  AND COALESCE(s.gc_buffer_busy,0)   > 0)
   )
  GROUP BY tw.event, tw.corr_type
)
SELECT
  tw.wait_scope                           AS "Scope",
  tw.wait_class                           AS "Wait Class",
  tw.event                                AS "Wait Event",
  tw.pct_db_time                          AS "% DB Time",
  tw.avg_wait_ms                          AS "Avg Wait (ms)",
  tw.total_waits                          AS "Total Waits",
  CASE
    WHEN tw.corr_type IS NULL OR tw.corr_type IN ('none','')
      THEN COALESCE(LEFT(tw.guidance_text,300),
           'No segment correlation — wait class: ' || tw.wait_class)
    WHEN cs.correlated_segments IS NULL
      THEN '⚠ No segment data yet — run schema/refresh_segment_mv.sql to fix'
    ELSE cs.correlated_segments
  END                                     AS "Correlated Segments / Advisory",
  CASE tw.corr_type
    WHEN 'io_read'     THEN 'Physical Reads'
    WHEN 'io_write'    THEN 'Physical Writes'
    WHEN 'buffer_busy' THEN 'Buffer Busy Waits'
    WHEN 'row_lock'    THEN 'Row Lock Waits'
    WHEN 'gc_cluster'  THEN 'GC Buffer Busy'
    WHEN 'none'        THEN '— not applicable —'
    ELSE                    '— not seeded —'
  END                                     AS "Correlation Basis"
FROM top_waits tw
LEFT JOIN corr_segments cs ON cs.event = tw.event
WHERE '${dbname}' != '' AND '${start_snap}' != '' AND '${end_snap}' != ''
ORDER BY tw.pct_db_time DESC;

matcher.options: ^(Phys Reads|Logical Reads|Buf Busy Waits|Row Lock Waits|Table Scans|GC Busy|Disk Reads|Buffer Gets|Executions|Parse Calls|Total Elapsed.*|Avg Elapsed.*|Total CPU.*|Total Waits|Avg Wait.*)$

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel 2: Top Segments → Implied Wait Classes + SQLs
-- SQL references filtered to selected snap range
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    split_part('${start_snap}',' - ',1)::int AS s_snap,
    split_part('${end_snap}',' - ',1)::int   AS e_snap,
    '${dbname}'   AS dbname,
    '${instance}' AS instance
),
top_segs AS (
  SELECT
    s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type,
    ROUND(AVG(s.severity_score)::numeric, 2)              AS severity,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.physical_reads,0))::numeric,0)   AS phys_reads,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.logical_reads,0))::numeric,0)    AS log_reads,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.buffer_busy_waits,0))::numeric,0)AS buf_busy,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.row_lock_waits,0))::numeric,0)   AS row_locks,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.physical_writes,0))::numeric,0)  AS phys_writes,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.gc_buffer_busy,0))::numeric,0)   AS gc_busy,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.table_scans,0))::numeric,0)      AS tbl_scans
  FROM awr_segment_summary_mv s
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname = s.dbname AND p.instance = s.instance
  WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
  GROUP BY s.owner, s.object_name, s.obj_type
  ORDER BY AVG(s.severity_score) DESC
  LIMIT 15
),
seg_meta AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(m.owner) AS owner, UPPER(m.object_name) AS object_name,
    m.object_type, m.num_rows, m.blevel, m.clustering_factor,
    m.index_type, m.partitioned, m.last_analyzed,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(m.object_type) LIKE 'INDEX%'
        THEN 'BLVL=' || COALESCE(m.blevel::text,'?') ||
             CASE WHEN m.blevel > 4 THEN ' ⚠BLVL-HIGH' ELSE '' END ||
             CASE WHEN m.clustering_factor IS NOT NULL AND m.num_rows > 0
                       AND (m.clustering_factor::numeric/m.num_rows) > 0.5
                  THEN ' CF=' || ROUND(m.clustering_factor::numeric/m.num_rows,2)::text || ' ⚠CF-POOR'
                  WHEN m.clustering_factor IS NOT NULL AND m.num_rows > 0
                  THEN ' CF=' || ROUND(m.clustering_factor::numeric/m.num_rows,2)::text
                  ELSE '' END ||
             COALESCE(' ' || NULLIF(m.index_type,'NORMAL'),'')
      WHEN UPPER(m.object_type) LIKE 'TABLE%'
        THEN 'rows=' || TO_CHAR(COALESCE(m.num_rows,0),'FM999,999,999') ||
             CASE WHEN m.partitioned='YES' THEN ' PART' ELSE '' END
      ELSE COALESCE(m.object_type,'')
    END AS meta_summary,
    CASE WHEN m.last_analyzed IS NOT NULL
              AND (NOW() - m.last_analyzed) > INTERVAL '30 days'
         THEN '⚠ STALE (' || to_char(m.last_analyzed,'DD-Mon-YY') || ')'
         ELSE to_char(m.last_analyzed,'DD-Mon-YY')
    END AS analyzed_label
  FROM awr_object_metadata m
  WHERE lower(m.dbname) = lower((SELECT dbname FROM params))
),
seg_wait_class AS (
  SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type,
    string_agg(wait_label, ', ' ORDER BY metric_val DESC) AS implied_waits
  FROM (
    SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type,
           'User I/O (phys_reads=' || phys_reads::text || ')' AS wait_label,
           phys_reads AS metric_val
    FROM top_segs WHERE phys_reads > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type,
           'Concurrency (buf_busy=' || buf_busy::text || ')' AS wait_label,
           buf_busy AS metric_val
    FROM top_segs WHERE buf_busy > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type,
           'Application (row_locks=' || row_locks::text || ')' AS wait_label,
           row_locks AS metric_val
    FROM top_segs WHERE row_locks > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type,
           'Cluster (gc_busy=' || gc_busy::text || ')' AS wait_label,
           gc_busy AS metric_val
    FROM top_segs WHERE gc_busy > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT owner, object_name, obj_type,
           'User I/O/scans (tbl_scans=' || tbl_scans::text || ')' AS wait_label,
           tbl_scans AS metric_val
    FROM top_segs WHERE tbl_scans > 0
  ) x
  GROUP BY owner, object_name, obj_type
),
-- SQL IDs filtered to the selected snap range
snaps_sqls AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(sql_id) AS sql_id
  FROM awr_sql_summary_mv
  WHERE dbname   = (SELECT dbname   FROM params)
    AND instance = (SELECT instance FROM params)
    AND begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
),
seg_sqls AS (
  SELECT
    lower(m.owner) AS owner,
    lower(m.object) AS object_name,
    string_agg(DISTINCT m.sql_id, ', ' ORDER BY m.sql_id) AS sql_ids
  FROM top_segs s
  -- Only SQL IDs active in the selected snap range
  JOIN snaps_sqls ss ON TRUE
  JOIN awr_sql_object_map_mv m
    ON lower(m.sql_id) = ss.sql_id
   AND (
     (m.owner <> '' AND lower(m.owner) = lower(s.owner) AND lower(m.object) = lower(s.object_name))
     OR
     (m.owner = ''  AND lower(m.object) = lower(s.object_name))
   )
  GROUP BY lower(m.owner), lower(m.object)
)
SELECT
  ts.obj_type                           AS "Type",
  ts.owner || '.' || ts.object_name     AS "Segment",
  ts.severity                           AS "Severity Score",
  COALESCE(sm.meta_summary, '—')        AS "Object Metadata",
  COALESCE(sm.analyzed_label, '—')      AS "Last Analyzed",
  COALESCE(swc.implied_waits, '—')      AS "Implied Wait Classes",
  COALESCE(ss.sql_ids, '— not in text map —') AS "Referencing SQLs (this snap range)",
  ts.phys_reads   AS "Phys Reads",
  ts.log_reads    AS "Logical Reads",
  ts.buf_busy     AS "Buf Busy Waits",
  ts.row_locks    AS "Row Lock Waits",
  ts.tbl_scans    AS "Table Scans",
  ts.gc_busy      AS "GC Busy"
FROM top_segs ts
LEFT JOIN seg_meta sm
       ON lower(sm.owner) = lower(ts.owner)
      AND lower(sm.object_name) = lower(ts.object_name)
LEFT JOIN seg_wait_class swc
       ON lower(swc.owner) = lower(ts.owner)
      AND lower(swc.object_name) = lower(ts.object_name)
      AND swc.obj_type = ts.obj_type
LEFT JOIN seg_sqls ss
       ON lower(ss.owner) = lower(ts.owner)
      AND lower(ss.object_name) = lower(ts.object_name)
WHERE '${dbname}' != '' AND '${start_snap}' != '' AND '${end_snap}' != ''
ORDER BY ts.severity DESC;

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel 3: Top SQL → Referenced Segments
-- Top SQL by severity with segments extracted from SQL text
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    split_part('${start_snap}',' - ',1)::int AS s_snap,
    split_part('${end_snap}',' - ',1)::int   AS e_snap,
    '${dbname}'   AS dbname,
    '${instance}' AS instance
),
top_sql AS (
  SELECT
    lower(s.sql_id)                                      AS sql_id,
    ROUND(AVG(s.severity_score)::numeric, 2)             AS severity,
    ROUND(SUM(s.elapsed_time_per_exec_s)::numeric, 2)    AS total_elapsed_s,
    ROUND(AVG(s.elapsed_time_per_exec_s)::numeric, 4)    AS avg_elapsed_s,
    ROUND(SUM(s.cpu_per_exec_s)::numeric, 2)             AS total_cpu_s,
    ROUND(SUM(s.disk_reads_per_exec)::numeric, 0)        AS disk_reads,
    ROUND(SUM(s.buffer_gets_per_exec)::numeric, 0)       AS buffer_gets,
    SUM(s.executions)                                    AS executions,
    ROUND(SUM(s.parse_calls)::numeric, 0)                AS parse_calls
  FROM awr_sql_summary_mv s
  JOIN params p ON p.dbname = s.dbname AND p.instance = s.instance
  WHERE s.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
  GROUP BY lower(s.sql_id)
  ORDER BY AVG(s.severity_score) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
-- Segments from text map (requires awr_sql_object_map_mv to be populated)
sql_segs AS (
  SELECT
    lower(m.sql_id) AS sql_id,
    string_agg(
      CASE WHEN m.owner <> '' THEN m.owner || '.' ELSE '' END || m.object ||
      COALESCE((
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN UPPER(om.object_type) LIKE 'INDEX%'
              THEN ' [idx BLVL=' || COALESCE(om.blevel::text,'?') ||
                   CASE WHEN om.blevel > 4 THEN ' ⚠HIGH' ELSE '' END || ']'
            WHEN UPPER(om.object_type) LIKE 'TABLE%'
              THEN ' [tbl rows=' || TO_CHAR(COALESCE(om.num_rows,0),'FM999,999,999') || ']'
            ELSE ''
          END
        FROM awr_object_metadata om
        WHERE UPPER(om.dbname) = UPPER((SELECT dbname FROM params))
          AND (m.owner = '' OR UPPER(om.owner) = UPPER(m.owner))
          AND UPPER(om.object_name) = UPPER(m.object)
        LIMIT 1
      ), ''),
      E'\n' ORDER BY m.object
    ) AS segments
  FROM awr_sql_object_map_mv m
  WHERE lower(m.sql_id) IN (SELECT sql_id FROM top_sql)
  GROUP BY lower(m.sql_id)
)--,
-- Top 3 foreground waits for this snap range
-- Shown as context — not per-SQL causation (AWR does not link waits to specific SQL)
--top3_waits AS (
  --SELECT string_agg(
   -- event || ' (' || pct::text || '% DB time)',
   -- ' | ' ORDER BY rn
 -- ) AS txt
 --FROM (
 --  SELECT
  --    w.event,
   --   ROUND(AVG(w.pct_time)::numeric,1) AS pct,
    --  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(w.pct_time) DESC) AS rn
  --  FROM awr_wait_summary_mv w
  --  JOIN params p ON p.dbname=w.dbname AND p.instance=w.instance
   -- WHERE w.begin_snap BETWEEN (SELECT s_snap FROM params) AND (SELECT e_snap FROM params)
    --  AND w.wait_scope = 'Foreground'
    --GROUP BY w.event
    --ORDER BY AVG(w.pct_time) DESC
    --LIMIT 3
  --) t
  --WHERE rn <= 3
--)
SELECT
  ts.sql_id                                                AS "SQL ID",
  ts.severity                                              AS "Severity Score",
  ts.total_elapsed_s                                       AS "Total Elapsed (s)",
  ts.avg_elapsed_s                                         AS "Avg Elapsed/Exec (s)",
  ts.total_cpu_s                                           AS "Total CPU (s)",
  ts.disk_reads                                            AS "Disk Reads",
  ts.buffer_gets                                           AS "Buffer Gets",
  ts.executions                                            AS "Executions",
  ts.parse_calls                                           AS "Parse Calls",
  COALESCE(ss.segments, '— not in text map —')             AS "Segments Referenced"--,
--  (SELECT txt FROM top3_waits)                             AS "Top 3 Waits (snap range — not per-SQL)"
FROM top_sql ts
LEFT JOIN sql_segs ss ON ss.sql_id = ts.sql_id
WHERE '${dbname}' != '' AND '${start_snap}' != '' AND '${end_snap}' != ''
ORDER BY ts.severity DESC;

✅ Active Recommendations — Rules Mode Only (switch to AI Recs page for AI mode)

panels.description: Shown in Rules mode only. For AI mode recommendations → Portal → 🤖 AI Recs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE severity
    WHEN 'critical' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL'
    WHEN 'high'     THEN '🟠 HIGH'
    WHEN 'medium'   THEN '🟡 MEDIUM'
    ELSE                 '🟢 LOW' END AS "Severity",
  category AS "Category",
  title AS "Issue",
  event_or_object AS "Event / Object",
  LEFT(root_cause, 200) AS "Root Cause",
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT string_agg(val, ' | ' ORDER BY ord)
     FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(resolution_json::jsonb)
          WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, ord)),
    resolution_json::text
  ) AS "Recommended Actions"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (category, title, event_or_object)
    severity, category, title, event_or_object,
    root_cause, resolution_json
  FROM awr_recommendations
  WHERE dbname = '${dbname}'
    AND begin_snap BETWEEN split_part('${start_snap}',' - ',1)::int
                       AND split_part('${end_snap}',' - ',1)::int
    AND '${dbname}' != ''
  ORDER BY category, title, event_or_object,
    CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2
      WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
) deduped
ORDER BY
  CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2
    WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  category;

list.label: Start Snap
list.name: start_snap
list.query: SELECT '' AS label UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT begin_snap::int || ' - ' || to_char(snap_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM awr_load_profile WHERE dbname='${dbname}' AND instance='${instance}' ORDER BY label NULLS FIRST;

list.label: End Snap
list.name: end_snap
list.query: SELECT '' AS label UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT begin_snap::int || ' - ' || to_char(snap_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM awr_load_profile WHERE dbname='${dbname}' AND instance='${instance}' ORDER BY label NULLS FIRST;
